kiloPass.legalDisclosure: Kilo Pass is an auto-renewable monthly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically each month at the price shown unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

consent.productAnalyticsNote: No prompt or conversation content is sent to product analytics.
consent.errorScreenshotsNote: Text and images are masked on your device before anything is sent.

consent.revokeSignOutMessage: Kilo needs this consent to function. Revoking will sign you out. You can accept again on next sign-in.
consent.declineSignOutMessage: Kilo needs to share data with AI providers to work. If you decline, you will be signed out.
consent.couldNotSaveChoice: Could not save your choice. Please try again.
consent.optionalReview: Optional — you can change this any time in Settings
consent.optionalOnboarding: Optional — on unless you turn it off
consent.aiProvidersWhat: Your prompts, conversation history, and any files you attach.
consent.aiProvidersWho: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and other providers you select per request.
consent.gatewayWhat: Account ID, request metadata, token usage.
consent.crashReportingWhat: Crash and error reports, with app content scrubbed.
consent.productAnalyticsWhat: App events (opens, screens viewed, feature use), device type, app version.
consent.productAnalyticsWhy: Measure app performance and understand how features are used.
consent.errorScreenshotsWhat: Masked screenshots when an error happens, and masked recordings of a small sample of sessions.
consent.errorScreenshotsWhy: See what the app displayed when something broke.
consent.installAttributionWhy: Understand which channels bring new users.
consent.voiceTranscriptionWho: On-device only, or Apple or Google when this device cannot transcribe offline.
consent.installAttributionPromptMessage: Kilo uses Apple's tracking permission only to learn which channel brought you here. Your prompts and conversations are never used.
